answer: Your ex has to sign the sale documents too, the same as any co-owner. The easiest way is for them to come to the appointment with their photo ID. If they can't come, they can sign power of attorney form NW-POA-2 electronically with no notary, except in Georgia, where it must be notarized. You don't need their signature if your divorce decree awards the car to you; just bring a certified copy of the decree. If the names on the title are joined by 'or' instead of 'and,' only one owner needs to sign. For the name mismatch, bring the document that shows your name change, such as your divorce decree or a court order, and sign the name change affidavit, form NW-NMC-1, at the appointment.
